name: Complementary Reimagined
compile_guard: {enabled} && defined MC_OS_MAC && MC_VERSION == 12101 && RP_MODE == 1 && defined OVERWORLD && defined GBUFFERS_WATER && !defined COMPOSITE && !defined GBUFFERS_COLORWHEEL_TRANSLUCENT && !defined DISTANT_HORIZONS && !defined DH_WATER && !defined DH_TERRAIN && !defined VOXY && !defined VOXY_PATCH && !defined VOXY_TRANSLUCENT && WORLD_SPACE_REFLECTIONS_INTERNAL == -1 && WORLD_SPACE_REFLECTIONS == -1 && WATER_REFLECT_QUALITY == 2
placement: After native GetReflection, lighting, composition, caller DoFog and all native alpha attenuation; immediately before original DRAWBUFFERS:03/gl_FragData[0] output.
native_alpha_semantics: Under exact scope final native terrain blend weight. WSR and mirror branches excluded; native AddBackgroundReflection alters only RGB, not alpha. Not probability, radiance energy, trace iteration count or strict miss indicator.

legend.blue: 0 <= native alpha <= 0.001: no above-floor retained terrain weight; possible tiny/rejected hit or miss, trace may still execute.
legend.green_dominant: 0.001 < native alpha <= 1: native terrain radiance-fetch branch necessarily executed; RGB=(0,0.75+0.25*alpha,0.25-0.25*alpha).
legend.magenta: Invalid/out-of-range alpha (including NaN comparisons failing): unknown.
legend.opacity: Final qualified water alpha=1 only for an unambiguous untimed witness after fog.

preserved: All original program bytes outside inserted final-output cue
Original GetReflection call, normals, lighting, fog and native color equations in source
All other material IDs and excluded dimensions/versions/options/DH/VOXY paths
Original native option bytes and License.txt
limitations: Final RGBA change intentionally destroys natural water appearance.
Compiler may eliminate newly dead color/background work; never benchmark this witness.
Green implies above-floor accepted native terrain blend alpha, not nonzero terrain radiance, substantial energy or speed headroom.
Blue does not prove zero tracing or zero raw hits.
Cue still passes through native downstream postprocessing; displayed RGB is not direct alpha readback.
No runtime cue result accepted by source build.
stopping_rule: One root-owned finite untimed witness in same retained scene/options. Missing eligible water/call/above-floor hit coverage stops A2 for this workload; no scene/preset rescue.
